title: User Registration with Valid Data
description: Verify that a user can successfully register with a valid email, strong password, and mandatory user details.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Input a valid email.
Input a strong password that meets complexity requirements.
Fill in all mandatory user details.
Submit the registration form.
Check that the registration is successful and a confirmation or welcome message is displayed.

title: User Registration with Invalid Email Format
description: Verify that registration fails when the user inputs an invalid email format.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Input an invalid email address (e.g., missing '@').
Input a strong password and fill mandatory details.
Submit the registration form.
Check that the system displays an appropriate error message for invalid email.

title: User Login with Correct Credentials
description: Verify that users can log in successfully using correct credentials and receive a valid JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Input valid email and corresponding password.
Click login button.
Verify login success and receipt of a valid JWT token.

title: User Login with Incorrect Password
description: Verify that login fails with an incorrect password and shows an appropriate error.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Input valid email and incorrect password.
Click login button.
Verify login failure with error message.

title: JWT Token Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Verify that users with different roles (User, Admin, Partner) can only access routes permissible for their role and receive authorization errors if they access unauthorized routes.

steps.description: Authenticate as a User role and attempt to access an Admin-only endpoint.
Confirm access is denied with appropriate authorization error.
Authenticate as an Admin role and access an Admin endpoint.
Confirm access is granted.
Authenticate as Partner role and attempt to access User-admin routes.
Confirm access is denied.

title: Upload Valid KYC Documents
description: Verify users can upload valid KYC documents of supported types (PDF, JPG, PNG) not exceeding the 5 MB limit.

steps.description: Login as a User.
Navigate to the document upload page.
Upload multiple documents of different valid types (e.g., Aadhaar PDF, PAN JPG).
Verify the files are accepted and successfully uploaded.

title: Upload KYC Document with Unsupported File Type
description: Verify that file uploads with unsupported file types are rejected with an appropriate error.

steps.description: Login as a User.
Attempt to upload a document with unsupported MIME type (e.g., .exe or .txt file).
Verify upload is rejected and an error message about invalid file type is displayed.

title: Upload KYC Document Exceeding Size Limit
description: Verify that attempts to upload files larger than 5 MB are rejected with appropriate error messages.

steps.description: Login as a User.
Attempt to upload a file larger than 5MB.
Verify the upload fails with a file size limit error.

title: Submit KYC Documents for Verification
description: Verify that users can submit uploaded KYC documents for admin review and the status updates correctly.

steps.description: Upload valid KYC documents as a User.
Submit documents for KYC review.
Check that submission status updates to 'Pending Review'.

title: Admin Approves Pending KYC Submission
description: Verify that an admin can approve a pending KYC submission and that the status updates and audit trail are recorded.

steps.description: Login as Admin.
Navigate to the verification queue.
Review a pending KYC submission and approve it.
Verify KYC status changes to 'Approved' and audit log entry is created.

title: Admin Rejects KYC Submission with Mandatory Reason
description: Verify that rejecting a KYC submission requires a mandatory rejection reason and updates status and audit logs accordingly.

steps.description: Login as Admin.
Navigate to the pending KYC submissions.
Attempt to reject a submission without providing a reason.
Verify that rejection is not allowed and an error prompts for a mandatory reason.
Provide a rejection reason and reject the submission.
Verify status updates to 'Rejected' and audit log records reason.

title: Add Valid Financial Transaction and See Credit Score Update
description: Verify that users can add valid credit or debit transactions with correct fields and that credit score recalculates based on the scoring engine.

steps.description: Login as User.
Add a transaction with valid type ('credit' or 'debit'), positive amount, and properly formatted date.
Verify transaction is saved and credit score updates accordingly.

title: Add Transaction with Invalid Type
description: Verify that adding a transaction with invalid type (not 'credit' or 'debit') is rejected with appropriate validation error.

steps.description: Login as User.
Attempt to add a transaction with type 'refund'.
Verify the system rejects the request with a validation error.

title: Transaction Pagination and Filtering
description: Verify that users can view transactions with pagination and filter by date range, type, and amount correctly.

steps.description: Login as User with multiple transactions.
Request transaction list with pagination parameters (page, size).
Verify the returned transactions match the requested page and size.
Apply filters by transaction type, date range, and amount.
Confirm filtered results match the criteria.

title: Credit Score Calculation Accuracy
description: Verify that the credit score falls within 300-900 range and accurately reflects weighted factors: total transactions, average amount, credit/debit ratio, frequency, and recent activity.

steps.description: Login as User.
Add varied transactions over different periods with different amounts and types.
Request current credit score.
Verify score is between 300 and 900 and logically consistent with transaction history.

title: Partner OAuth-like Account Linking
description: Verify that a third-party partner can initiate secure OAuth-like linking, obtain user consent, and access user KYC status and credit data.

steps.description: Partner initiates account linking request.
User authenticates and explicitly consents.
Verify partner receives access tokens.
Partner requests KYC status, credit score, and transactions APIs with token.
Verify data is returned securely and correctly.

title: Partner API Access with Invalid API Key or Token
description: Verify that partner API access is denied when API key or JWT token is invalid or missing.

steps.description: Send request to partner API with invalid or missing API key.
Verify access is denied with appropriate error.
Send request to partner API with invalid or expired JWT token.
Verify access is denied with authorization error.

title: Request Validation Middleware Rejects Invalid Data
description: Verify that all API endpoints reject requests with invalid or missing required data, such as malformed emails, incorrect transaction formats, or unauthorized roles.

steps.description: Attempt registration with missing mandatory fields.
Verify validation error is returned.
Attempt to add transaction with negative amount.
Verify validation error is returned.
Attempt to access admin routes without admin role.
Verify authorization error is returned.

title: Global Error Handler Consistency
description: Verify that when API errors occur, the global error handling middleware returns consistent and properly formatted JSON error responses.

steps.description: Make API request that triggers a server error (e.g., malformed data causing internal exception).
Verify response status and JSON error structure are consistent and contain message, error code, and path info.

title: Database Integrity on KYC Document Upload and Transactions
description: Verify that database operations on KYC documents and transactions use parameterized queries preventing SQL injection and maintain schema integrity.

steps.description: Attempt to upload KYC document with malicious payload in filename or metadata.
Verify database query parameters are sanitized and no injection succeeds.
Add financial transactions with suspicious input strings in description or amount fields.
Verify database rejects injection attempts and transaction is either sanitized or rejected.

title: Frontend API Client Token Management and Error Handling
description: Verify that the React frontend API client correctly manages authentication tokens with storage, refresh, and handles API error responses gracefully.

steps.description: Login to acquire JWT token.
Simulate token expiration and trigger an API request.
Verify client handles token expiration by prompting re-login or token refresh.
Make API requests resulting in errors (validation, forbidden, server errors).
Verify error messages are displayed to users properly without client crash.

title: User Dashboard Displays Accurate Status and Data
description: Verify that the user dashboard correctly displays current KYC status, credit score, transaction summaries, and enables navigation to key features.

steps.description: Login as user with existing transactions and completed KYC.
Verify dashboard shows current KYC status accurately.
Verify credit score matches backend calculation.
Verify recent transactions summary is correctly displayed.
Use navigation links to access document management and transactions.
Verify navigation is successful and UI updates accordingly.

title: Admin Panel Displays Verification Queue and Audit Logs
description: Verify that admins can see a queue of pending KYC requests, view uploaded documents, perform approvals/rejections with reasons, and audit logs are accessible.

steps.description: Login as Admin.
Open admin panel and navigate to verification queue.
Verify that all pending requests are listed accurately.
Select a submission to view documents.
Confirm documents are viewable and downloadable.
Perform approval and rejection actions with mandatory reason for rejection.
Verify status update and audit trail entries.
Access audit logs interface.
Verify audit entries correspond correctly to admin actions.
